groups.title: Document
groups.description: Root document elements, header, history, and common children.

groups.title: Substation
groups.description: Substation topology: substations, voltage levels, bays, equipment, functions, and process model.

groups.title: IED
groups.description: IED configuration: access points, servers, logical devices, logical nodes, data sets, and control blocks.

groups.title: Communication
groups.description: Communication network: sub-networks, connected access points, addressing.

groups.title: DataTypeTemplates
groups.description: Data type templates: LNodeType, DOType, DAType, EnumType and their children.

groups.title: Other
groups.description: Elements that span multiple domains or are not classified above.

AllocationRole.documentation: Definition of an allocation role allowing definition of possible allocation to devices type without using virtual IED

AllocationRoleRef.documentation: Allocation role attached to the application type

AnalogueWiringParametersRef.documentation: Specification of the analogue wiring parameters expected for the current SourceRef when ServiceType is Wired

Application.documentation: Application definition to be added at Process, Substation, Voltage Level or Bay level

ApplicationSclRef.documentation: Reference to the ASD files used to create an Application

BayType.documentation: Bay type element is keeping value of the type. It's a free string

BehaviorDescription.documentation: Element allowing to describe the behavior its parent (Application, Bay, Function, LN...)

BehaviorDescriptionRef.documentation: Reference to a behavior description attached to current role

BehaviorReference.documentation: Reference to a behavior description when for example a manufacturer wants to indicate its implementation of a user specification described by another behavior description

BinaryWiringParametersRef.documentation: Specification of the binary wiring parameters expected for the current SourceRef when ServiceType is Wired

CheckoutID.documentation: Element used by an IED to indicates that a file has been imported to give engineering rights on this IED. This is opening a transaction between both projects to lock it on first project until the checkout is given back from current project, which then lock the IED locally

CommunicationServiceSpecifications.documentation: The CommunicationServiceSpecifications is containing parameters used to create control blocks during implementation

ControlRef.documentation: Reference to a control data in the process

DOS.documentation: Data Object specification. To be added to LNode SCL element

FunctionCatRef.documentation: Reference to a function which is part of the current category

FunctionCategory.documentation: Category of functions. To be added to Process, Line, Substation, VoltageLevel and Bay SCL elements

FunctionCategoryRef.documentation: Reference to a function category attached to current role

FunctionRef.documentation: Reference to a function definition attached to current allocation role

FunctionRole.documentation: Role attached to the application type

FunctionRoleContent.documentation: an instance of the current role. In case of application type definition, instance 1 is the default instance

FunctionSclRef.documentation: Reference to the FSD files used to create a Function. Could be added under Function/SubFunction/EqFunction/EqSubFunction

FunctionTemplate.documentation: Base element for FSD format, will be used as a template element for Function/SubFunction or EqFunction/EqSubFunction

FunctionalSubVariant.documentation: Sub variant of the current variant

FunctionalVariant.documentation: Variant attached to the application type

FunctionalVariantGroup.documentation: Group of variants attached to the application type

FunctionalVariantRef.documentation: Ref to a functional variant of the Application

GooseParametersRef.documentation: Specification of the communication parameters expected for the current SourceRef when ServiceType is GOOSE

InputVar.documentation: Input variable used in the behavior description

InputVarRef.documentation: Reference to InputVar belonging to current behavior description

LNodeDataRef.documentation: Reference to Data belonging to current role

LNodeInputRef.documentation: Reference to SourceRefs belonging to current role

LNodeInputs.documentation: List of specification inputs of the given LNode. To be added at LNode level

LNodeOutputRef.documentation: Reference to ControlRefs belonging to current role

LNodeOutputs.documentation: List of specification outputs of the given LNode. To be added at LNode level

LNodeSpecNaming.documentation: LNode user specification. To be added to LNode SCL element

LogParametersRef.documentation: Specification of the Log parameters expected for the current DAS when Log capability is required

OutputVar.documentation: Output variable used in the behavior description

OutputVarRef.documentation: Reference to OutputVar belonging to current behavior description

PowerSystemRelationRef.documentation: Reference to a power system relation attached to current role

PowerSystemRelations.documentation: Functional relation from a Function/SubFunction to another element of the process

ProcessEcho.documentation: Definition of an echo LNode, mirroring the DO of another LNode

ProcessResourceRef.documentation: Reference to a process resource attached to current role

ProcessResources.documentation: List of Process Resources related to a function. to be added to the SCL elements Function, SubFunction, EqFunction and EqSubFunction

Project.documentation: Element allowing to define a project, to identify the project and the process elements defined by this project

ProjectProcessReference.documentation: Reference to the process elements belonging to the current project

ReportParametersRef.documentation: Specification of the communication parameters expected for the current SourceRef when ServiceType is Report

Resource.documentation: resource bound to this element could be multi

SMVParametersRef.documentation: Specification of the communication parameters expected for the current SourceRef when ServiceType is SMV

ServiceSpecifications.documentation: The ServiceSpecification is containing parameters used to create control blocks or physical interface (LPDI/LPDO) during implementation

SignalRole.documentation: Signal list attached to the referenced function in the context of the cureent Role definition

SourceRef.documentation: Reference to a data in the process

SubCheckoutID.documentation: When an IED is checkedout for a collaborative work by an SCC, it may be required to give right to a subpart of the collaborative project. So a CheckoutID may have an additional SubCheckoutID giving IED to nother project

Variable.documentation: A Variable is a way to define a global variable which can be modified by a user and applied to a list of SCL attributes

VariableRef.documentation: Reference to a variable attached to current role
